patch_description: Add a final simultaneous nonlinear-programming polish in diameter-normalized coordinates. The coordinate perturbation phase can only improve one point at a time and is inefficient once the optimum is determined by many coupled short- and long-distance contacts. Formulate the exact problem as maximizing a squared minimum distance `r`, subject to every squared pair distance lying in `[r, 1]`. Fixing one point removes translation, while the upper constraints normalize the diameter. SLSQP can then move all 14 points coherently and directly optimize the evaluator's squared-ratio objective. The result is retained only if its exact measured ratio improves the existing candidate, and the optional import/failure path preserves the current robust search result.
